reviews.body:
Requesting changes on four 🟡 IMPORTANT items. The core biology is sound — the meningococcal LptD-delivery vs canonical LptDE separation, the H44/76-vs-MC58 strain discipline, the lptH naming decision and the yedD/LptY UniProt source_defect are all well done, and all PMIDs, PANTHER labels, GO ancestry claims and supporting quotes I checked hold up.

1. Gitignored `.cache/` artifacts are committed (`.gitignore:65`), including the full text of a copyrighted Springer minireview (`2024-review.txt`, PMID:38816673) and a 1.6 MB genome blob — while seven PSEPK notes files cite `.cache/module-audit-logs/lps-20261107/psepk-consultation/falcon-*.log` paths that are NOT committed. Please pick one convention and keep consultation material under `analysis/module_audits/`.

2. `interpro/panther/PTHR45772`: `GO:0015920` went from `SUBFAMILY_ONLY` + `applicable_subfamilies: [PTHR45772:SF10]` to `UNRESOLVED`. The stated reason concerns uncertainty *within* SF10, which does not undo the well-supported exclusion of the amino-acid ABC clades that the old value encoded. `SUBFAMILY_ONLY` + `member_exceptions` (as this PR already uses in PTHR30189) keeps both facts.

3. `genes/ECOLI/lptE/lptE-ai-review.yaml:711-714`: the LptE LPS-binding/plug core function is supported by a PMID:41285762 quote entirely about LptY and LptM. (The same quote in `lptD` is on-topic; this is one misplaced row.)

4. Curation framing has migrated into `description` and family `summary` fields (lptM, yedD, NEIMB/lptE; PTHR33529 and PTHR30189 summaries lost concrete architecture for hedging). Per CLAUDE.md these belong in `notes`, `review.reason`, `coherence_reason` or `scope_reason`.

Plus five 🔵 suggestions (Neisseria quotes routed through a same-PR file, methodological vs factual supporting_text, an NEIMH/lptD reason/quote mismatch, terminal-variant taxon coverage, and diff readability). Full detail in the review comment: https://github.com/ai4curation/ai-gene-review/pull/6190#issuecomment-6706030710
